title: Denim, Reframed
category: Remake — Classic Calvin Klein Jeans Trucker Shirt
concept: An everyday icon, recut in digital form.
description: Denim follows the body in a close-fitting silhouette. A classic shirt collar and two chest pockets anchor the familiar construction, while precise topstitching traces each seam. Recreated through digital patternmaking and fabric simulation, the shirt retains the structure of its physical reference with a deliberately restrained volume.

construction.pockets: Two patch pockets at the chest.
construction.seams: Defined panel seams, traced with precise topstitching.
construction.volume: Controlled ease, held close to the body.
